exclusions.reason: Title, Berlin date, identity wording and incidental legal citation metadata are provenance; BITV2011 date checked and accurate, not a separate material claim.

Uniform standard satisfying all Länder, explicit dynamic BITV reference in ITKV and requirement that mandated services be accessible are policy recommendations. They do not assert that all existing Länder rules are identical, that no accessibility duty already applies or that adding text guarantees outcomes.

limitations: Exact response receipt unverified; authored date printed 14 September 2026.
